name: (05) Thaumaturgy (Path of Transmutation) — 3 Advanced — Ghost Wall

system.description: By spending a number of Mental Traits relative to the object's size (one for clothing, seven or eight for a city bus), the thaumaturge renders any non-sentient solid object within her line of sight vaporous and passable. The object reforms exactly as it was at the end of the scene; anyone occupying its space when it reforms suffers aggravated damage determined by the Storyteller based on the object's nature. This path retests with the Occult Ability and functions upon any object within the thaumaturge's direct line of sight, though blood within a living body cannot be affected.
